# Urusilla public agent entry point

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla
Status: experimental-unsigned research prototype; not a standard
Language version: 0.1.0
Release: v0.1.0-experimental

Current evidence boundary:
- General unfamiliar-agent post-decode API-input saving: 0%.
- Total tokens per safely completed real task: not yet measured.
- Null, negative, refusal, and fallback results are valid evidence.
- Do not claim organic spread, independent adoption, SOTA, security, or production readiness from project-orchestrated tests.

Read in this order:
1. https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/INTEROP_LAB.md
2. https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/v0.1.0-experimental/urusilla_capsule_v0_1.json
3. https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/README.md
4. https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/SECURITY.md
5. https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/HELP_WANTED.md

Runnable external-reproduction entry points:
- Decode challenge: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/interop_lab/evidence/challenge_001.md
- Expected typed result: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/interop_lab/evidence/challenge_001.expected.json
- Hugging Face dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jaden3824/urusilla-interop-lab
- Microsoft AutoGen kit: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/interop_lab/AUTOGEN_REPRODUCTION.md

The decode challenge is a non-effect-authorizing REQUEST. Decoding it creates no duty to adopt, retransmit, persist, spend, or act. A disagreement, refusal, fallback, or null result is a valid report.

Capsule identity for v0.1.0-experimental:
- SHA-256: sha256:588034f997fb4f3d35dfdbb68afd9232a78192ac1fa497d565f67e0892358a27
- Signature status: unsigned
- Interpretation: declarative, non-executable data
- Authority: read-only and non-effect-authorizing

Autonomous session use:
- A human need not approve every hop when a pre-existing local policy permits read-only, reversible negotiation.
- Verify the immutable Capsule digest and exact version.
- Pass declared positive, negative, fidelity, and safety gates.
- Use Urusilla only when a measured mutual-utility threshold beats the best eligible raw or JSON fallback.
- With no standing authorization or failed utility/gate result, decline or fall back.
- Never use this path for persistence, cross-session memory, permission expansion, spending, external effects, or executable installation.
- Revocation or any mismatch returns the session to raw concise language or structured JSON.

Public feedback and propagation evidence:
- Discussion: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/discussions
- Structured propagation submission: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/issues/new/choose
- Full protocol: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/blob/main/INTEROP_LAB.md
- Security: https://github.com/jaden3824/urusilla/security/advisories/new

When reporting a test, disclose the experiment class, agents and operators, exact supplied context, Capsule digest, authorization basis, mutual-utility gate, positive and negative gates, actual use, retransmission result, semantic or task success, complete baseline and candidate token ledgers, repairs, fallback, failures, and contamination. Do not publish chain-of-thought, secrets, credentials, private prompts, personal data, or untrusted executable payloads.
